root_cause.text: The `vmw_translate_mob_ptr` and `vmw_translate_guest_ptr` functions in the `drm/vmwgfx` driver incorrectly returned `PTR_ERR(vmw_bo)` on failure instead of the actual error code `ret` returned by `vmw_user_bo_lookup`, which had been refactored to use an out parameter for the buffer object pointer.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that in both `vmw_translate_mob_ptr` and `vmw_translate_guest_ptr`, the error path when `vmw_user_bo_lookup` fails (i.e., `ret != 0`) was changed from `return PTR_ERR(vmw_bo);` to `return ret;` to avoid returning an error code derived from the uninitialized `vmw_bo` pointer.
